name: Discount
definition: Decrease of the value of goods and / or services by applying a discount rate to the original amount.

DiscountAppliedAmount.name: Discount Applied Amount
DiscountAppliedAmount.definition: Amount of money that results from the application of an agreed discount to the amount due and payable to the creditor.

DiscountType.name: Discount Type
DiscountType.definition: Specifies the type of discount applied to the original amount.

DiscountBasisAmount.name: Discount Basis Amount
DiscountBasisAmount.definition: Amount used as a basis to calculate the discount amount.
